recipe.visualDefinition: A central hand-painted portrait of three long-haired men in 1970s attire, framed by a vibrant blue border containing stylized indigenous-inspired motifs, all set against a light natural wood grain background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject figures integrated into a flat, graphic border
High-contrast primary colors against neutral wood texture
Rough, painterly textures clashing with clean wood grain
Symmetrical framing of the central trio
coreInvariants: Visible wood grain texture as the outermost frame
Stylized red and yellow graphic icons in the border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned centrally, waist-up, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a bright yellow shirt acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top display text down to the central figures, then circulating around the graphic border icons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial wood grain border provides breathing room around the central artwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural wood tan (background) and Teal-blue (inner field).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and bright yellow (border icons and clothing).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic border elements contrasted with the muted, realistic tones of the portraiture.

characterSpecificRedesigns: K with a high junction point

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating on wood grain above the blue field

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Rustic, hand-drawn display type paired with functional, small-scale sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Reflects the organic, carved nature of the layout

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution light oak wood grain background. In the center, place a teal-blue rectangle with a rough, hand-painted edge. Inside the blue rectangle, paint three men with long hair in 1970s denim and yellow shirts. Surround the men with a border of red and yellow stylized indigenous-inspired animal motifs (eyes, hands, masks).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn uppercase serif lettering at the top center in black. Add two lines of small, clean sans-serif text in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the wood grain texture visible behind the central art?
Are the border motifs stylized with thick black outlines?
Does the main text have flared, irregular terminals?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the portrait
mustRedesign: Exact indigenous tribal crests (use generic inspired forms)

mustAchieve: Integration of organic wood and graphic paint

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the wood grain
Check that the blue field has a 'painted' edge rather than a sharp crop
Verify the figures look like a hand-painted portrait, not a raw photo
Confirm the border icons are balanced around the central subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Light wood grain base + Teal painted inset + Hand-painted portrait + Formline-inspired graphic border + Custom flared serif typography.
